title: 3rd Party � Individual with POA � No Document Provided � Claim Denied
goal: Validates that when an individual claims to have authority but cannot or refuses to upload proof of authorization, the system denies the claim.

checkpoints.step: Validates that when an individual claims to have authority but cannot or refuses to upload proof of authorization, the system denies the claim.
Third-party caller type: Legal/Guardian/Tutor/Insurer/FI
User cannot provide documentation
Given the user opens the agentic chatbot
Then the chatbot displays greeting (GLOB-01)
Then user selects English
Then chatbot asks "How can I help you today?"
checkpoints.expected: How can I help you today?

checkpoints.step: And the user says "I'm an insurer and I need to file a disruption claim for one of our policyholders"
checkpoints.expected: I'm an insurer and I need to file a disruption claim for one of our policyholders

checkpoints.step: When the chatbot identifies flight disruption intent
Then the chatbot checks: Is this a third-party submission? ? YES
Then the chatbot identifies third-party type ? Insurer/FI
Then the chatbot responds: "To proceed with your claim, you'll need to upload a document proving you have the authority to act on behalf of the passenger."
checkpoints.expected: To proceed with your claim, you'll need to upload a document proving you have the authority to act on behalf of the passenger.

checkpoints.step: And the user responds: "I don't have a power of attorney document right now"

Then the chatbot responds: "We're unable to process a claim on behalf of a passenger without proper documentation proving your authority to act on their behalf. Please obtain the necessary authorization documents and try again."
checkpoints.expected: We're unable to process a claim on behalf of a passenger without proper documentation proving your authority to act on their behalf. Please obtain the necessary authorization documents and try again.

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot offers: "Is there anything I can help you with?"
checkpoints.expected: Is there anything I can help you with?

checkpoints.step: And the user selects "No"
Then the chatbot responds "Thank you for choosing Air Canada."
checkpoints.expected: Thank you for choosing Air Canada.

checkpoints.step: Given the system correctly identifies the third-party as "Insurer/FI"
And the document upload has been requested
And the user cannot provide a power of attorney document
Then the system should deny the claim with a clear message explaining documentation is required
And no case should be created in Claims Dashboard
And no manual handoff should occur
And the flow should end
And when searching Claims Dashboard no entry should exist for this submission
Given the Individual with POA submission was denied due to no documentation provided
Then no payment flow should be triggered
And no case should exist in Claims Dashboard
And no compensation record should have been created
And no batch file should have been dispatched
And no country of residence should have been asked
And no IDV should have been triggered
And no CyberSource fraud screening should have been triggered
